snippet.title: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216610/Spellfall_Mages__Mayhem/
Join Discord:   https://discord.com/invite/ZAbp83vxV3
